source.name: Levitate
source.originalDescription: After using a move: increases movement speed by 50% for 2s (decaying by 5% every 0.25s). Increases movement speed by 10% while near an ally Latios. When not in combat, this Ability can be used to fly to an allied Latios. This Ability goes on cooldown for 90s after it's triggered for both Latios and Latias. While channeling this ability the user can move around, once the 2s channel is completed the user becomes unstoppable and flies to where Latios was when this ability was activated. If Latios is at the home base, the cooldown of Levitate goes down twice as fast for Latias.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Levitate は 妨害無効になる、移動速度を上げる、次の通常攻撃または強化攻撃を準備する。

source.name: Mist Blast
source.originalDescription: Aims at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team and charges power for 1.8s before releasing a pulse, damaging all opposing Pokémon hit. Resets move cooldowns immediately after releasing the pulse, and increases cooldown reduction by 20% for 9.5s. If Latios is also aiming its Unite Move at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, the pulses stack and explode, dealing damage around the target as well. If Mist Blast hits last then the explosion uses Latias' stats. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Mist Blast は シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う。
